ENGLISH LANGUAGE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading.

4. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

5. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. blue
   C. run
   D. quickly

6. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Creative Writing.

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.

   A. going
   B. went
   C. goed
   D. goes

10. When practising Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening.

12. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

13. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.

15. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a joining word
